_doc: Drift motion spec. One source of truth for Windows (Composition SpringNaturalMotion: damping ratio + period) and Linux (AdwSpringAnimation: damping ratio + mass + stiffness). Springs are given as damping ratio (1 = critically damped, <1 = bouncy) and response in ms (the undamped period). drift-design converts. Animate transforms and opacity only.

settle.use: state changes: idle -> found -> PIN -> transferring -> done

snappy.use: small UI reactions: hover, press, toggles

drop.use: a received file dropping into place (soft single overshoot)

breathe.use: idle dot breathing, looped back and forth

puff.use: done: the ball puffs out edge to edge

reduced_motion._doc: When the OS asks for reduced motion: no springs, no loops; crossfade only.

throughput_visual._doc: Particle/dash speed along the phone->PC line scales with real throughput (log scale), clamped.
